title: Are asset flips suddenly acceptable as long as they're labeled 'No AI'?
author: AkandoGames
selftext:
I've noticed more and more games that look like straight asset flips getting positive attention just because they're advertised as "NO AI"

Some are basically "clean this cinema" or "clean this supermarket" with bought asset packs and barely any original gameplay. And ironically, some of them probably use AI to write the code anyway ... 🙄 

I have nothing against using asset packs. They're tools, just like AI.

But since when did "No AI" become a quality standard? Is a low-effort asset flip somehow better than a genuinely interesting game made with AI?

Curious what you guys think
